Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
database.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Utility class that manages database connections and initialization. It provides a centralized access point to the MySQL server and ensures the underlying schema and tables exist before the game server starts accepting requests. Supports both direct database connection and environment setup with administrator privileges.

  • Method Details

    • getConnection

      public static Connection getConnection() throws SQLException
      Establishes and returns a new connection to the configured game database.
      Returns:
      a valid Connection object linked to the MySQL database
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs, the credentials are wrong, or the MySQL server is unreachable

    • initializeDatabase

      public static void initializeDatabase(DatabaseConfig dbConfig) throws SQLException
      Initializes the database by attempting connection to the target database. If the database and user exist, attempts to create the match_archive table if missing. Otherwise, throws an SQLException that will be handled by the caller.
      Parameters:
      dbConfig - the DatabaseConfig containing connection parameters
      Throws:
      SQLException - if connection fails, credentials are invalid, or SQL operations fail

    • setupEnvironmentWithRoot

      public static void setupEnvironmentWithRoot(String rootUser, String rootPassword, DatabaseConfig dbConfig) throws SQLException
      Sets up the database environment using administrator credentials. This is a fallback method that uses root credentials to create the database, the specified user, and grant appropriate permissions. Used when the target database or user does not yet exist.
      Parameters:
      rootUser - the MySQL root user or an administrator user with global privileges
      rootPassword - the password for the administrator user
      dbConfig - the DatabaseConfig containing connection parameters for the target database
      Throws:
      SQLException - if connection fails or SQL operations fail

    • isEnabled

      public static boolean isEnabled()
      Determines whether database persistence is currently enabled.
      Returns:
      true if database operations are enabled, false otherwise

    • disable

      public static void disable()
      Disables database persistence for subsequent operations.
